observations: Photo 0: Front of a DSLR body with 'Canon' logo, 'EOS 5D' and 'Mark II' labels clearly visible; body cap is on, no lens attached.
Photo 1: Rear of the same body, LCD screen appears blank/off, 'Canon' logo visible, no memory card or battery compartment shown open.
Photo 2: Bottom plate shows a label reading 'Canon DS126201', serial number, and 'Made in Japan' markings, consistent with a Canon 5D Mark II body.
No lens, battery, charger, strap, or box is shown in any photo.
No power-on, shutter count, or image-sample shot is provided.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 both show 'Canon' branding and 'EOS 5D Mark II' / 'Canon DS126201' labels, not Sony.

claims.claim: Canon EOS 5D Mark II is a full-frame DSLR with a 21.1-megapixel sensor (generic description, not a specific condition claim).
claims.evidence: This is generic product text, not a claim about this specific unit's condition or functionality.

risks.proof: A clip or photo of the camera powered on, showing the LCD live view and a test shot.

risks.risk: No lens, battery, or charger included, which are needed for a usable kit.
risks.proof: Photo showing included accessories (battery, charger, lens) alongside the body.

risks.risk: Shutter count unknown; high-mileage units lose value and reliability.
risks.proof: A photo of the shutter count from a diagnostic app or EXIF data of a test shot.
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case as high-mileage/unknown

risks.risk: Seller's text misidentifies the brand as Sony, raising doubt about the reliability of the rest of the listing's claims.
risks.proof: A clear, consistent seller description matching the photographed item.
risks.if_unproven: treated as an unreliable listing description; price based on photos only

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a test photo.
Photo of the shutter count display or a test image's EXIF data.
Photo showing battery, charger, and any lens included in the sale.
Close-up of the sensor (with lens off) to check for dust, scratches, or fungus.
response.reason: Photos clearly identify a Canon EOS 5D Mark II body (no lens/accessories, power-on unverified), so it can be priced at worst case as a non-verified, body-only full-frame DSLR despite the seller's contradictory Sony claim.
